cohort: The study included 120 ASA Grade I and II patients with normal singleton full term/near term pregnancies undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: All three vasopressors (Phenylephrine, Ephedrine, and Mephentermine) are effective in maintaining maternal arterial pressure during spinal anesthesia for cesarean section, but Phenylephrine has a quicker peak effect and a higher incidence of bradycardia.
